title: Crunchyroll Reveals English Dub Cast, Staff for 2nd Seasons of Black Clover, Aoashi Anime
content: Crunchyroll announced on Saturday the cast and staff members, and the release date for the English dub of the second season of the Black Clover and Aoashi series. The first English dub episode for the second anime season based on Yūki Tabata 's Black Clover manga started streaming on Saturday.
